title: Hearty Greek Cheese Pilaf
description: A savory and pillowy Greek dish featuring a sweet and tangy glaze, perfect for a quick-fix meal, and sugar-free-friendly with the use of natural sweeteners and blue food colouring for a unique twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the uncooked pilaf rice and stir to coat the rice with oil and heat for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, honey free sweetener, and blue food colouring if using, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is cooked.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the crumbly feta cheese, pitted kalamata olives, canned artichoke hearts, and dried sun dried tomatoes.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
To make the glaze, mix the lemon juice and honey free sweetener in a small bowl until well combined.
Drizzle the glaze over the pilaf and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional olives, artichoke hearts, and sun dried tomatoes if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
